rows.label: qst630405_msg0002
rows.name:
Superbian dogs... All right, men! Get
them!

rows.label: qst630405_msg0102
rows.name:
They don't look willing to listen...
We have no choice but to fight!

rows.label: qst630405_msg0201
rows.name:
They probably won't believe us even if
we say we're not Superbian dogs.

rows.label: qst630405_msg0202
rows.name: Looks like we have no choice...

rows.label: qst630405_msg0302
rows.name: We have no choice but to fight, mo!?

rows.label: qst630405_msg0402
rows.name: Let's cool their heads a little.

rows.label: qst630405_msg0502
rows.name:
...But they aren't listening. I'll
show them what Thunderclap Zeke can
do!
